title: fix(console): Home's build chip and /ai read the agent catalog on a deployment without AI
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbDZiPLsrXtX5sZKRTuAwBEC)_

Fixes #26614

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:没有 AI 智能体的部署上(`GET /api/v1/ai/agents` 为空或不可用),首页问候行的「构建应用」改为「在 Studio 中新建」,点开即进入 Studio 首页并直接弹出新建软件包对话框(`/studio?new=package`);没有「管理元数据」权限的会话则不显示这个按钮(「从模板开始」仍带着原因说明)。直接访问 `/_console/ai` 不再静默跳回首页,而是原地显示「AI 助手不可用 · 当前部署未启用 AI 助手」,带「返回首页」按钮,有权编写的管理员还会看到同一个「在 Studio 中新建」链接。有智能体的部署一切照旧。
- **为什么改**:在 HotCRM 本地(18.2.0、无 AI 智能体)上,「构建应用」承诺了一个无法开始的 AI 搭建,而 `/ai` 把人一声不响地送回首页,读起来像坏链接。
- **风险与回滚**:低。没有新端点、没有 spec 改动、没有元数据键;只读已有的智能体目录读数(`useAgents` 的同一份缓存)。按钮会等目录读数返回再画,所以有 AI 的部署上「构建应用」比以前晚一帧出现。新增发布面:i18n 键 `home.build.inStudio`(十个语言包)、`STUDIO_NEW_PACKAGE_PATH` 常量、`AiUnavailable` 抽成独立模块。`RequireAiSurface` 的 `redirectTo` prop 保留原名,改为决定该页面「返回首页」去哪。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`(`useHomeAiAvailability` 的 `aiResolved` 与两枚构建按钮);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx`(`RequireAiSurface` 不再重定向);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`(`?new=package` 深链接)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/RequireAiSurface.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.newPackageDeepLink-26614.test.tsx`,预期全绿;或在没有 AI 的本地运行时打开 Console 首页,看到「在 Studio 中新建」,再打开 `/_console/ai` 看到「当前部署未启用 AI 助手」。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Home's build chip reads the agent catalog.** `useHomeAiAvailability` (the Home's existing `useAgents` read of `GET /api/v1/ai/agents`, no second fetch path) now also reports `aiResolved`, with `useAiSurfaceEnabled`'s latch, so the chip waits for the catalog's answer instead of drawing one form and swapping to the other. For an admin on a runtime with `features.aiStudio` on:

| catalog | may author | chip |
|---|---|---|
| one or more agents | yes | "Build an app" (「构建应用」) to `/studio`, unchanged |
| one or more agents | no | "Build an app", dimmed with its reason, unchanged |
| empty or failed | yes | "New in Studio" (「在 Studio 中新建」) to `/studio?new=package` |
| empty or failed | no | no build chip; "Start with a template" keeps the reason |
| not answered yet | any | no build chip |

**`/ai` with no agent.** `RequireAiSurface` (`console/ConsoleShell.tsx`, the guard on the three `/ai` routes in `apps/console/src/App.tsx`) no longer redirects home. It renders the AI-unavailable screen in place, in a full-height frame: the title and description already in every pack (`console.ai.unavailableTitle`, `console.ai.unavailableDescription`: 「AI 助手不可用」 · 「当前部署未启用 AI 助手。其他功能一切正常。」), "Back to home" to the declared landing (objectui#7373, unchanged), and, for an admin who may author on a runtime with `features.aiStudio` on, a "New in Studio" link to `/studio?new=package`. That screen was `AiChatPage`'s private `AiUnavailable` (shown when the catalog resolves empty after the gate); it moves to `console/ai/AiUnavailable.tsx`, and both render it. `redirectTo` keeps its name (renaming a published prop breaks every host that passes it) and now sets where the screen's way home leads.

**Studio's new-package flow.** `/studio?new=package` opens the Studio landing (`BuilderLanding`) with its create-package dialog open, and drops the param with a replace, so a refresh or Back does not reopen it. The path's one spelling is `STUDIO_NEW_PACKAGE_PATH` in `views/studio-design/studioNewPackage.ts`, a module of its own so Home and the `/ai` gate do not import `BuilderLanding` into the console's eager closure (`apps/console/src/components/studioBuilder.ts` says why). `new` is a page-scoped param of the landing, not one of `urlParams.ts`'s reserved names.

**i18n.** One new key, `home.build.inStudio`, in all ten packs. The order named two new strings; the second (「此部署未启用 AI 助手」) already exists as `console.ai.unavailableDescription`, so it is reused, not added.

**Callers of `RequireAiSurface`.** Measured with `git grep`: the only element callers are the three `/ai` routes in `apps/console/src/App.tsx`, and they change as described. `console/AppContent.tsx` and `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` name it only in comments, which this PR corrects; neither wraps anything with it. `ui/e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts` names it in a comment only and pins no redirect. Five `apps/console` tests stub it as a pass-through, unchanged.

## Tests

- `console/home/__tests__/HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614.test.tsx` (new, real `HomePage`, a catalog stand-in that moves as `useAgents` does: empty first frame, loading, answer): with an agent, "Build an app" to `/studio` and dimmed for a non-author; with none, "New in Studio" to `/studio?new=package`; with none and no authoring capability, no build chip while the template chip keeps the reason; while the catalog is in flight, neither form.
- `console/__tests__/RequireAiSurface.test.tsx`: the no-agent case now asserts the screen in place (no redirect, no retry); the Studio link for an admin who may author, and its absence for a non-admin, a non-author and a runtime without authoring; the two objectui#7373 cases now click the screen's "Back to home" and land on the declared landing or the launcher.
- `views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.newPackageDeepLink-26614.test.tsx` (new, real `BuilderLanding` under a real router): the dialog opens on arrival and the param leaves the address; other params stay; the bare landing and an unknown value open nothing.
- `console/__tests__/bootRedirectCoverage.test.tsx`: the no-agent case is no longer a redirect; it still asserts the deciding commit covers the viewport, which the screen's full-height frame does.
- `console/home/__tests__/HomePage.greetingAndApps-12601.test.tsx`: its catalog stand-in now holds one custom agent, so the builder-chip cases it pins keep the "Build an app" form they were written for.

## Acceptance notes

- The screenshot of the home on a runtime without AI is not attached: this container has no HotCRM deployment.
- On a transient `/agents` failure the guard now shows the same "not enabled" screen it used to redirect away from: `useAiSurfaceEnabled` reports no error, so the guard cannot tell a failure from an empty catalog. `AiChatPage`'s own screen, reached when the guard passes, still tells them apart and offers a retry.
- With agents present, the build chip appears once the catalog answers rather than on the first frame.

## Verification

All local readings below were taken in a worktree on this branch; heads named per reading.

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every app-shell and console test file that names `HomePage`, `ConsoleShell`, `AiChatPage`, `BuilderLanding`, `AiUnavailable` or `studioNewPackage` (132 files, from `git grep -l`), plus `packages/i18n/` whole: `Test Files 221 passed (221)`, `Tests 2414 passed | 13 skipped (2427)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. This is a declared narrowing; CI's Test UI shards run the full suite.
</details>

- Every `BuilderLanding.*` test and every `StudioRoute*` test: `Test Files 14 passed (14)`, `Tests 93 passed (93)`.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 64 tasks successful. On d566d91c, `--filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/console --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 72 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 178 passed, 2 skipped files; 5065 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (from `ui/`): 0 new citations.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the changed ui files: 0 errors (warnings only, of rules already warned across these files).
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: dispatch-gates --commands, 35 families, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 35 commands from the diff; each ran with its exit code recorded, all 0 (two of them, `check:query-options-erasure` and `check:type-check-debt`, re-run without the 300 s cap that first stopped them). `--ran` reconciliation: "35 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The derived set reads paths only, and the last commit touched no new path. Type-check lanes, wide-population families and the always-run tail are CI's.
</details>

`dogfood_battery`: not run (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
